name: ontology-driven-dev
description: Build and query domain ontologies, then check governed changes during the Codex lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Make domain rules explicit and check changes
interface.longDescription: Write the entities, relationships, vocabulary, intent and invariants of a project, then surface ontology findings in Codex. Includes session context, feedback after patch and shell tools, and an end-of-turn check. The Claude Code observer pane is separate.
defaultPrompt: Set up an ontology for this project.
Check my changes against the project ontology.
